name: VictoriaLogs
description: High-performance, cost-effective log management from VictoriaMetrics — single-binary deployment with a built-in query UI, LogsQL query language, and automatic pod log collection via Vector.

setup_commands.command: helm repo add vm https://victoriametrics.github.io/helm-charts/ --force-update && helm repo update vm
setup_commands.label: Adding VictoriaMetrics Helm repo

setup_commands.command: helm upgrade --install vls vm/victoria-logs-single --version 0.13.8 --namespace logging --create-namespace --set server.image.tag=v${VERSION} --set server.retentionPeriod=7d --set server.persistentVolume.enabled=true --set server.persistentVolume.size=10Gi --wait --timeout 8m
setup_commands.label: Installing VictoriaLogs (single-binary)

setup_commands.command:
helm upgrade --install vector vm/vector --version 0.9.0 --namespace logging --set 'customConfig.sources.kubernetes_logs.type=kubernetes_logs' --set 'customConfig.sinks.vlogs.type=elasticsearch' --set 'customConfig.sinks.vlogs.inputs[0]=kubernetes_logs' --set 'customConfig.sinks.vlogs.endpoints[0]=http://vls-victoria-logs-single-server.logging.svc.cluster.local:9428/insert/elasticsearch/' --set 'customConfig.sinks.vlogs.mode=bulk' --set 'customConfig.sinks.vlogs.healthcheck.enabled=false' --wait --timeout 5m 2>/dev/null || kubectl apply -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: vlogs-collector
  namespace: logging
  labels:
    app: vlogs-collector
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vlogs-collector
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vlogs-collector
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: vlogs-collector
      tolerations:
        - effect: NoSchedule
          operator: Exists
      containers:
        - name: vector
          image: timberio/vector:0.44.0-alpine
          args: ["--config", "/etc/vector/vector.yaml"]
          env:
            - name: VECTOR_SELF_NODE_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: spec.nodeName
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/vector
            - name: varlog
              mountPath: /var/log
              readOnly: true
            - name: varlibdockercontainers
              mountPath: /var/lib/docker/containers
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi}
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: vlogs-collector-config
        - name: varlog
          hostPath:
            path: /var/log
        - name: varlibdockercontainers
          hostPath:
            path: /var/lib/docker/containers
EOF
setup_commands.label: Deploying log collector (Vector)

setup_commands.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: vlogs-collector
  namespace: logging
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: vlogs-collector
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods", "namespaces", "nodes"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: vlogs-collector
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: vlogs-collector
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: vlogs-collector
    namespace: logging
EOF
setup_commands.label: Configuring RBAC for log collector

setup_commands.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: vlogs-collector-config
  namespace: logging
data:
  vector.yaml: |
    sources:
      kubernetes_logs:
        type: kubernetes_logs
        self_node_name: "${VECTOR_SELF_NODE_NAME}"
    transforms:
      remap_logs:
        type: remap
        inputs: ["kubernetes_logs"]
        source: |
          .stream = del(.kubernetes.pod_labels)
          ."_msg" = del(.message)
    sinks:
      vlogs:
        type: elasticsearch
        inputs: ["remap_logs"]
        endpoints:
          - http://vls-victoria-logs-single-server.logging.svc.cluster.local:9428/insert/elasticsearch/
        mode: bulk
        healthcheck:
          enabled: false
        request:
          headers:
            VL-Stream-Fields: stream,kubernetes.pod_namespace,kubernetes.pod_name,kubernetes.container_name
EOF
setup_commands.label: Applying Vector config

setup_commands.command: kubectl rollout restart daemonset/vlogs-collector -n logging 2>/dev/null || true && kubectl -n logging rollout status daemonset/vlogs-collector --timeout=120s 2>/dev/null || true
setup_commands.label: Restarting collector with updated config

setup_commands.command: [ -f /var/run/vlogs-pf.pid ] && kill $(cat /var/run/vlogs-pf.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; nohup kubectl -n logging port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 svc/vls-victoria-logs-single-server 9428:9428 >/var/log/vlogs-portforward.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/var/run/vlogs-pf.pid; sleep 2; echo 'VictoriaLogs UI ready on :9428'
setup_commands.label: Starting VictoriaLogs port-forward

teardown_commands.command: kubectl delete daemonset vlogs-collector -n logging --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete configmap vlogs-collector-config -n logging --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete serviceaccount vlogs-collector -n logging --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete clusterrole vlogs-collector --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete clusterrolebinding vlogs-collector --ignore-not-found
teardown_commands.label: Removing log collector
